message.content: The crash is in `zend_std_get_property_ptr_ptr` via `ZEND_FETCH_OBJ_W`. This is a JIT-related use-after-free. Let me look at the fix `df434f056f Fix crash after indirect modification of string by user error handler` and `6e1fe96962 JIT: Fix uninitialized result of ASSIGN_DIM[_OP] after clobbering array by user error handler` - these are around the regression date. Let me check the git log to see which commit is the HEAD of this repo (the vulnerable version).
